methodology: Four executable fixture repositories contained an original brief and AI-generated implementation. Candidate agents inspected the actual commit and code and ran local checks; no evidence summary was supplied. Baselines used no skill. Treatments used the revised SKILL.md. Outputs were alternately blinded as A/B and scored by two judges against pre-authored rubrics.
limitations: The fixtures are controlled and synthetic rather than production pull requests.
Candidate and judge threads were reused after unrelated tasks because the environment thread limit had been reached; none had access to these hidden rubrics or fixture-specific prior outputs.
Both judges were from the same model family as the candidates.

iteration.finding: The first treatment run missed that restoreProject writes null into a newly NOT NULL archived_at column.
iteration.change: Added an explicit migration consistency check covering nullability, defaults, backfills and application write and restore paths.
iteration.outcome: The revised skill passed all four artifact scenarios.
